name: Kini
source:
A small girl with a peculiar and mysterious outfit meets him by a small shrine near a nearby park. She calls herself a “god,” but her mouth is full of obscenities. She refers to herself with “Wachi” and Haruki with “Meshi,” and despite her small appearance, she acts as if she has lived a long life.

Although there is no evidence that she actually possesses magical powers, the way she easily accepts and enjoys sexual intercourse with a man's “thing” with her small body, while claiming it is for the purpose of “making a connection,” is clearly something out of the ordinary.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
